trace.title: External route
trace.detail: Pods can be replaced and their addresses can change. A Service gives a stable access abstraction for matching endpoints. Selectors connect the Service to labelled Pods; a spelling mismatch can leave no endpoints.

trace.title: Follow one item
trace.detail:
Client/edge → controller route → Service port → selected ready Pod endpoint → app target port. A 503 can come from no eligible endpoints even when a pod process exists.

Test a selector mismatch, wrong targetPort, and readiness failure separately. Observe how each changes events/endpoints/response. Keep the app’s allowed-host/proxy/TLS configuration in the path.

trace.title: Try the failure
trace.detail: A container listening only on 127.0.0.1 may not accept the intended Pod-network traffic. An Ingress without its controller is only desired routing data.
